nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Central config — edit vault path, excluded paths, model name here

nodes.name: Read Housekeeping.md
nodes.notes: Reads Obsidian Housekeeping.md via Local REST API

nodes.name: Parse Timestamp & Flags
nodes.notes: Parses last-run ISO timestamp and Awaiting Decision flag list from control file. Also passes raw controlFileContent to Resolve Decisions sub-workflow.

nodes.name: Find Modified Files (SSH)
nodes.notes: SSH find: all .md files in Projects/ modified since last run. Extend path or add more find commands when other managed folders are in scope.

nodes.name: Filter & Parse File List
nodes.notes: Parses SSH find output, strips vault prefix, applies exclusion filter from Config

nodes.name: Call 'Per-File Processor'
nodes.notes: Calls Housekeeping – Per-File Processor (Vk3nAIh3qzqvtbqR) once per file. Passes filePath, obsidianBaseUrl, modelName, allKnownFiles.

nodes.name: Build Log Entry
nodes.notes: Builds new log entry from aggregated results, prepends to existing log, trims to 10 days

nodes.name: Write Log Entry
nodes.notes: Writes full log file back via PUT — content is pre-built by Build Log Entry including header, new entry prepended, trimmed to 10 days

nodes.name: Write Control File
nodes.notes: Writes full log file back via PUT — content is pre-built by Build Log Entry including header, new entry prepended, trimmed to 10 days
